name: Monstera Deliciosa
description: The iconic split-leaf philodendron. Thrives in bright, indirect light and grows into a lush statement piece.

name: Snake Plant
description: Upright, architectural leaves edged in gold. Nearly indestructible and happy in low light.

name: Fiddle Leaf Fig
description: Large, violin-shaped leaves on a slender trunk. A favorite for sunny living room corners.

name: Golden Pothos
description: Trailing vines with marbled green and gold leaves. Perfect for shelves and hanging baskets.

name: ZZ Plant
description: Glossy, waxy leaflets that tolerate drought and dim offices. Ideal for beginners.

name: Classic Terracotta Pot
description: Breathable, unglazed clay that helps prevent overwatering. Includes a drainage hole.

name: Speckled Ceramic Planter
description: Hand-glazed stoneware with a soft speckled finish. Pairs beautifully with leafy greens.

name: Macramé Hanging Planter
description: Hand-knotted cotton hanger with a sage pot. Brings plants up to eye level.

name: Self-Watering Planter
description: A built-in reservoir and water-level gauge keep roots evenly moist for up to two weeks.

name: Organic Potting Mix
description: A chunky, airy blend of coir, bark, and perlite made for tropical houseplants.

name: Liquid Plant Food
description: Gentle, balanced fertilizer for weekly feeding during the growing season.

name: Neem Leaf Shine Spray
description: Cleans dusty leaves and adds a natural shine while deterring common pests.

name: Brass Watering Can
description: A long, narrow spout delivers water precisely to the soil, not the leaves.

name: Pruning Shears
description: Sharp stainless steel blades for clean cuts when trimming and propagating.

name: Soil Moisture Meter
description: No batteries required. Probe the soil to know exactly when it's time to water.
